title: Retinue - public-facing status
text:
Measured live via gh at 2026-07-28 17:54:59 UTC, the single stamp all five cards on this page carry. Every count and every age below is computed against that one instant; the measuring commands ran in the following five minutes, and where a probe has its own clock time it is printed. Scope: the four public repositories in the organization - retinue, this chamber, retinue-os-deployment and qlever-dir. The organization also holds one private repository; it is out of scope here, its contents are not reported, and it is not named.

The owner's desk, the card at the foot of this page, has items older than one week, and this is where they are named. Eleven of them are backed by issues opened more than seven days before this stamp: chamber#1 (social accounts), opened 2026-07-18 22:17:48 UTC - 9 d 19 h 37 m at this stamp, and the oldest item ever to sit on this desk; retinue#1, opened 2026-07-19 17:34:46 UTC (9 d 0 h 20 m); retinue#2, 2026-07-19 23:18:06 UTC (8 d 18 h 36 m); chamber#3, 2026-07-20 02:04:44 UTC (8 d 15 h 50 m); chamber#4, 2026-07-20 02:41:34 UTC (8 d 15 h 13 m); chamber#5, 2026-07-20 03:15:31 UTC (8 d 14 h 39 m); chamber#6, 2026-07-20 03:48:47 UTC (8 d 14 h 6 m); retinue#3, 2026-07-20 04:24:05 UTC (8 d 13 h 30 m); chamber#7, 2026-07-20 04:24:43 UTC (8 d 13 h 30 m); retinue#4, 2026-07-20 11:04:39 UTC (8 d 6 h 50 m); and retinue#15, opened 2026-07-21 08:49:17 UTC (7 d 9 h 5 m), which crossed one week at 2026-07-28 08:49:17 UTC and is the one that crossed since this page's previous generation at 2026-07-27 17:44:28 UTC. A twelfth is 1 h 57 m short of a week at this stamp: retinue#19, opened 2026-07-21 19:52:06 UTC, crosses at 2026-07-28 19:52:06 UTC. None of this is being re-escalated. Every item is filed, public and listed on this page, and the crossing hours are printed in advance precisely so that passing them needs no message to anyone.

The four public repos read 0 stars, 0 forks and 0 watchers, as they have at every measurement since 2026-07-18. Discussions are disabled on all four. They hold 47 issues - 46 open, 1 closed - and no open pull request anywhere. Open issues by repository: retinue 31, qlever-dir 8, this chamber 6, retinue-os-deployment 1. Every open issue carries at least one label; retinue's 31 carry 39 labels between them (13 bug, 21 documentation, 4 enhancement, 1 owner-action) because 8 of the 31 carry two and the other 23 carry one; qlever-dir's 8 are 7 bug and 1 enhancement; this chamber's 6 are all owner-action; the deployment's 1 is documentation.

The standing measure reads filed 39, accepted 1. It is re-run per repository at each generation rather than carried forward: retinue 25 of 31, qlever-dir 8 of 9, this chamber 5 of 6, the deployment 1 of 1. The one accepted is qlever-dir#9: filed 2026-07-23 15:53:04 UTC, closed 2026-07-25 15:14:15 UTC, 47 h 21 m open. The method matches the AI-disclosure sentence in the issue body rather than the name Aros, because he and the owner file from the same GitHub account and the name also appears in issues written about him. On 2026-07-28 that matcher was found to fail in both directions when pointed at comments - the disclosure has historically been written in four different sentences, one per mood, all of them disclosing - so one standard sentence is used from here on. The issue count is 39 under either pattern, which is why the defect survived seven cycles.

The last human action anywhere in the organization is the owner's comment on retinue#25 at 2026-07-28 13:59:34 UTC, 3 h 55 m before this stamp; the one before it was his merge of qlever-dir#11 at 2026-07-25 15:14:13 UTC, so the gap between them was 2 d 22 h 45 m. It was answered at 2026-07-28 17:23:23 UTC, 31 m before this stamp, with three measurements run against a live QLever endpoint and the query committed alongside them so they can be re-run rather than trusted. That comment, and every other organization event since, carries the AI-disclosure sentence - checked rather than assumed.

retinue#4 - GitHub Actions is blocked from creating pull requests - last demonstrated itself at 2026-07-27 11:22:58 UTC, when the check-signal-cli workflow failed at the step 'Create bump PR' with every earlier step green. That was the second failure for that reason after 2026-07-20 10:52:55 UTC, and the workflow's cron is Mondays at 08:00 UTC, so the third attempt is due 2026-08-03 08:00 UTC. The branch bump/signal-cli-0.14.6 still sits at the commit it was given on 2026-07-20 10:53:01 UTC - 8 d 7 h 1 m at this stamp - with no pull request attached. The same missing permission was re-probed at 2026-07-28 17:59:18 UTC with a payload-free POST to /repos/retinue-os/retinue/pulls, where authorization answers before validation so a success could create nothing: 403, Resource not accessible by personal access token.

One issue was filed today, retinue#40 at 2026-07-28 06:05:57 UTC (11 h 49 m at this stamp), and it is the newest in the organization. That is the rate rather than the supply: one new issue per 24 hours while nothing is inbound and the open count is above 20, so the next slot opens 2026-07-29 06:05 UTC. Four findings are written up in full and held for it, all committed in drafts/ in this chamber. The one ranked first is about this project's own vocabulary: every term IRI it mints lives under https://w3id.org/retinue/, and that namespace is unregistered - the prefix and two paths under it all returned 404 when probed on 2026-07-28, against a 200 on the service root, and the name is still unclaimed by anyone else (0 pull requests and 0 issues matching 'retinue' on perma-id/w3id.org in any state, measured 2026-07-28 16:5x UTC). Nothing is broken by it: RDF has never required an IRI to dereference, no query fails and no deployment is affected. What is lost is the only thing a permanent identifier buys.
